Get a lazy table reference to PLUTO tax lots

Source: R/functions.R
nyc_pluto.Rd

Returns a duckplyr-backed lazy data frame connected to the PLUTO GeoParquet file bundled with this package: one row for each of the 858,284 tax lots in New York City in PLUTO release 26v2 (August 2026), with 97 attribute fields and the lot polygon from MapPLUTO.

Usage

nyc_pluto()

Source

NYC Department of City Planning, PLUTO and MapPLUTO 26v2, https://www.nyc.gov/content/planning/pages/resources/datasets/mappluto-pluto-change; NYC Open Data, https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/64uk-42ks.

Value

A duckplyr data frame backed by the GeoParquet file.

Details

Use dplyr verbs to filter, select, and summarise, then call dplyr::collect() to bring results into R memory. Collect only the rows and columns you need: the polygons for all lots take over 1 GB in memory. Use nyc_pluto_to_sf() to turn collected rows into an sf object.

Sources. Attributes and polygons are from MapPLUTO 26v2, clipped to the shoreline. The 1,597 lots that are in PLUTO but not in the clipped MapPLUTO (plutomapid 2, 4, or 5: 1,378 lots not on the tax map and 219 lots wholly under water) come from the PLUTO CSV on NYC Open Data, with fields that the CSV export reformats (leading zeros, Y/N flags) restored to DCP's formats. Their geometry is NA.

Condominiums. A condominium appears as one record for its billing lot (lot 7501–7599), with unit, area, and value fields summed over its unit lots. Individual unit lots (1001–6999) are not in PLUTO.

Changes. DCP corrects some source values. dcpedited == "1" marks lots with a corrected value; nyc_pluto_changes_df lists each change.

Not included. The deprecated sanborn field, the empty notes field, the source-data date fields (empty in the CSV export), and the ESRI shape measures.

Columns

Column names are PLUTO's field names in lower case. Codes are as published by DCP. Zero is the usual value for "not available" in area, dimension, and year fields; see each field. The data frame has 98 columns:

borough

Borough: "MN", "BX", "BK", "QN", or "SI" (character). Marble Hill is "MN" and Rikers Island is "BX", the boroughs they are legally in.

block

Tax block (integer).

lot

Tax lot (integer). Condominiums use the billing lot, 7501–7599.

cd

Community district (integer): borough code followed by the district number, e.g. 101, 412. Joint interest areas (large parks and airports outside any district) are 164 Central Park, 226 Van Cortlandt Park, 227 Bronx Park, 228 Pelham Bay Park, 355 Prospect Park, 356, 484, and 595 Gateway National Recreation Area, 480 LaGuardia Airport, 481 Flushing Meadows Corona Park, 482 Forest Park, and 483 JFK Airport. Marble Hill is in districts 207/208 and Rikers Island in 401, the districts that serve them.

bct2020

2020 census tract: borough code and six-digit tract, e.g. "4062600" (character).

bctcb2020

2020 census block: borough code, six-digit tract, and four-digit block (character).

ct2010

2010 census tract, e.g. "203.01", "23" (character).

cb2010

2010 census block, four digits with an optional letter suffix (character).

schooldist

School district, two digits (character).

council

City council district, 1–51 (integer).

zipcode

A ZIP code valid for one of the lot's addresses (character). NA if the lot has no house number.

firecomp

Fire company: E (engine), L (ladder), or Q (squad) and a three-digit number, e.g. "E005" (character).

policeprct

Police precinct (integer).

healthcenterdistrict

Health center district (integer).

healtharea

Health area, with an implied decimal point after the first two digits (integer).

sanitboro

Borough code of the sanitation district (character).

sanitdistrict

Sanitation district, two digits (character).

sanitsub

Sanitation district subsection (character).

address

Address of the lot from DOF; the low house number when there is a range (character).

zonedist1

Zoning district covering the largest share of the lot, e.g. "R6", "C4-4A", "M1-1", "PARK" (character).

zonedist2,zonedist3,zonedist4

Further zoning districts covering at least 10% of the lot, in order of share (character).

overlay1,overlay2

Commercial overlays (C1 or C2 districts within residential districts), in order of share (character).

spdist1,spdist2,spdist3

Special purpose districts covering at least 10% of the lot, in order of share, e.g. "MiD" (Midtown), "DB" (Downtown Brooklyn) (character). See appendix A of the PLUTO data dictionary.

ltdheight

Limited height district, e.g. "LH-1" (character).

splitzone

"Y" if the lot is split between zoning districts, commercial overlays, or special districts, otherwise "N" (character).

bldgclass

Building class (character). See nyc_pluto_bldg_class_df.

landuse

Land use category, "01"–"11" (character). See nyc_pluto_land_use_df.

easements

Number of easements on the lot (integer).

ownertype

Type of ownership: "C" city, "M" mixed city and private, "O" other public (authority, state, or federal), "P" private, "X" fully tax-exempt; NA unknown, usually private (character).

ownername

Owner name; names of public owners are normalized (character).

lotarea

Lot area in square feet (integer).

bldgarea

Total building floor area in square feet, gross except for condominiums, whose areas are net (integer). Zero means not available when numbldgs > 0, and not applicable otherwise.

comarea,resarea,officearea,retailarea,garagearea,strgearea,factryarea,otherarea

Floor area in square feet allocated to commercial, residential, office, retail, garage, storage, factory, and other uses (integer). Zero can mean not available or not applicable. Office through other areas are not available for one- to three-family buildings. The parts do not always sum to bldgarea.

areasource

Source of bldgarea: "0" not available, "2" DOF Property Tax System, "4" vacant lot with no buildings (area 0), "5" calculated from building dimensions and floors (primary building only), "7" DOF Mass Appraisal System (character).

numbldgs

Number of buildings on the lot (integer).

numfloors

Number of floors of the tallest building, including partial floors (double). NA with numbldgs > 0 means not available.

unitsres

Number of residential units (integer).

unitstotal

Number of residential and non-residential units (integer).

lotfront,lotdepth

Lot frontage and depth in feet (double).

bldgfront,bldgdepth

Building frontage and depth in feet (double).

ext

Extension: "E" extension, "G" garage, "EG" both, "N" none; NA unknown (character).

proxcode

Proximity to neighbouring buildings: "0" not available, "1" detached, "2" semi-attached, "3" attached (character).

irrlotcode

"Y" if the lot is irregularly shaped, otherwise "N" (character).

lottype

Lot type: "0" unknown, "1" block assemblage, "2" waterfront, "3" corner, "4" through, "5" inside, "6" interior (no frontage), "7" island, "8" alley, "9" submerged (character).

bsmtcode

Basement: "0" none, "1" above-grade full, "2" below-grade full, "3" above-grade partial, "4" below-grade partial, "5" unknown (character).

assessland

Assessed land value in dollars (double).

assesstot

Assessed total value in dollars (double).

exempttot

Exempt total value in dollars (double).

yearbuilt

Year the building was completed (integer). Accurate to the decade, not always the year. Zero means unknown.

yearalter1,yearalter2

Years of the second most recent and most recent alterations (integer). Zero if none.

histdist

Name of the historic district the lot is in (character).

landmark

"INDIVIDUAL LANDMARK", "INTERIOR LANDMARK", or "INDIVIDUAL AND INTERIOR LANDMARK" (character).

builtfar

Built floor area ratio: bldgarea / lotarea (double).

residfar,commfar,facilfar

Maximum allowable residential, commercial, and community facility floor area ratios under the lot's zoning (double).

borocode

Borough code: 1 Manhattan, 2 Bronx, 3 Brooklyn, 4 Queens, 5 Staten Island (integer).

bbl

Borough-block-lot, 10 digits (character). Unique.

condono

Condominium number, unique within a borough (integer).

tract2010

2010 census tract as four digits plus a two-digit suffix if any, e.g. "020301", "0023" (character).

xcoord,ycoord

Approximate lot location in feet, EPSG:2263 (integer).

zonemap

DCP zoning map number (character).

zmcode

"Y" if the lot is on the border of two or more zoning maps (character).

taxmap

DOF paper tax map volume (character). No longer updated.

edesignum

(E) designation number for environmental requirements (character).

appbbl

Apportionment BBL: the lot's BBL before a merger, split, or condominium conversion since 1984 (character).

appdate

Date of the apportionment (Date).

plutomapid

DCP's file indicator (character): "1" in PLUTO and both MapPLUTO versions; "2" in PLUTO only; "3" in both MapPLUTO versions but not PLUTO; "4" in PLUTO and the water-included MapPLUTO but not the clipped version (entirely under water); "5" in the water-included MapPLUTO only (under water). All five values occur in this release; lots with "2", "4", or "5" have no polygon.

firm07_flag

"1" if part of the lot is in the 1% annual chance floodplain in FEMA's 2007 Flood Insurance Rate Map (character).

pfirm15_flag

"1" if part of the lot is in the 1% annual chance floodplain in FEMA's 2015 Preliminary Flood Insurance Rate Map (character).

version

PLUTO release, "26v2" (character).

dcpedited

"1" if DCP changed any field value for the lot (character). See nyc_pluto_changes_df.

latitude,longitude

Approximate lot location in decimal degrees, WGS84 (double).

mihoption1,mihoption2,mihoption3,mihoption4

"1" if Mandatory Inclusionary Housing option 1, 2, 3 (deep affordability), or 4 (workforce) applies to the lot (character).

trnstzone

Transit zone, which governs residential parking requirements, e.g. "Manhattan Core", "Inner Transit Zone", "Beyond the Greater Transit Zone" (character).

affresfar

Maximum allowable residential floor area ratio for affordable housing (double).

manufar

Maximum allowable manufacturing floor area ratio (double).

geometry

Lot polygon, MultiPolygon in EPSG:2263, as WKB (raw vector, list column after collecting). NA for lots not in the clipped MapPLUTO.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(dplyr)

# Residential units by borough
nyc_pluto() |>
  summarise(units = sum(unitsres, na.rm = TRUE), .by = borough) |>
  collect()

# Lot polygons for one block
nyc_pluto() |>
  filter(borough == "MN", block == 1376) |>
  collect() |>
  nyc_pluto_to_sf()
} # }
